<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Majins''' are a magical and unpredictable race with enormous destructive potential and a unique ability to regenerate and change form. Though they may seem playful or childish, they are extremely dangerous when they unleash their true power. In DragonMineZ a Majin can '''absorb''' weaker players and mobs to take part of their power, heals more from food, and gets more out of healing techniques than any other race.
</translate>

<translate>
== Overview and strengths == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
* '''Absorption.''' Absorb a weaker player or mob to heal and permanently copy part of its STR, SKP and PWR, up to three times.
* '''Sweet Tooth.''' Food heals you 25% more.
* '''Healing Magic.''' Your healing techniques heal more, cost less and recharge faster, and you receive more healing from them.
* '''Knockdowns.''' While Absorption is selected, your finishing blows knock enemies down instead of killing them.
</translate>

<translate>

</translate>

| <translate><!--T:13--> '''Absorption'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:14--> Select the racial skill in the '''X''' menu and '''hold G for 4 seconds''' while aiming at a weaker player or mob within '''8 blocks''', or at a knocked-down player. The target is absorbed: you heal '''30%''' of your max health and permanently gain '''4%''' of its '''STR, SKP and PWR''' (mobs use their max health). Up to '''3''' absorptions, with a '''600 seconds''' cooldown. You can eject an absorption from the '''X''' menu (click its slot twice), which locks that slot for '''300 seconds'''. You lose '''all''' absorptions when you die.</translate>

|-

|}

<translate>
<!--T:19-->
While Absorption is the selected action, your finishing blows knock enemies down instead of killing them, so you can absorb them. Server owners can limit Absorption to players only. Your absorptions can be reset with the '''Reset Passive''' wish or <code>/dmzracial reset</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Racial Skills#Resetting racial progress|Racial Skills]]).
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:38-->
''Level'' is the level of the form skill (Super Forms or Legendary Forms) that unlocks the form, and ''TP cost'' is the price of that level. Each form after the first of its group also needs '''25% mastery''' on the previous one. One number in the ''STR / SKP / PWR'' column means the three stats share it. Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. ''Ki drain'' is the base upkeep per tick ("—" means no Ki upkeep); see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Energy consumption while transformed|energy consumption]].

<!--T:39-->
* '''Ultra Majin''' is the Majin top tier: the strongest Majin form, but [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] never copies it. It also makes each attack cost 3.5 times as much stamina.
* The '''Demon''' group is the Majin Legendary line. It can't be bought with TP by default: the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] grants its levels, and Mutants can borrow them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Legendary forms|Legendary forms]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Appearance == <!--T:40-->
</translate>
{{Main|Character Customization}}
<translate>
<!--T:41-->
* '''Head:''' Majins wear a '''head tentacle''' (head parts <code>majin1</code> to <code>majin3</code>) and can also wear a hairstyle at the same time.
* '''Gender:''' yes. Male and female body types share the same grid, so picking a body type also picks your gender.
* '''Body types:''' 3 for each gender, with body type 0 as the default.
* '''Face:''' besides their own nose and mouth options, Majins can pick the human ones, listed after their own.
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:42-->

<!--T:43-->
* A [[Special:MyLanguage/Glind|Glind]] of the opposite alignment deals only '''5%''' more damage to Majins, instead of the usual 10% (see Light and Darkness).
* The Majin race is not the same as the '''Majin''' effect, the mark that [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi|Babidi]] gives to players with low alignment (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects|Effects]]).
* Only Majins can equip three of [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu|Majin Buu]]'s techniques: Gum Punch, the Mystic Ball Attack and Sleep Recovery (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques#Learning techniques|Techniques]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:44-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:45-->
Absorption, Sweet Tooth and Healing Magic are tuned in the <code>majin</code> section of <code>racialSkills</code> in <code>general-server.json</code>, including whether mobs can be absorbed (<code>absorptionOnMobs</code>). The Super Forms TP ladder is in <code>races/majin/character.json</code>, and each form's values are in its form file.
</translate>
{{See also|General Server Config|Custom Races|Custom Forms}}
